assertions.name: framing_is_pure_phase_fibre_probability_framing_free_all_blocks
assertions.source: At a fibre root of unity zeta, d_zeta(lambda)=[mark]_zeta is real (SU(2) sin-ratio character) and theta_lambda(zeta)=zeta^{c(lambda)} is a pure phase (|theta|=1), so the fibre probability |S_0lambda*theta^f|^2 = |S_0lambda|^2 = W_lambda(zeta) for every one of the 7 blocks lambda|-5. Hence the observable W_lambda(q0) (Habiro-continued from the root-of-unity probabilities, #3681) is framing-free for ALL blocks; the q0^{f*c} residual is an amplitude-ordering artifact, not the physical observable. No fit.

description: Geometric W_lambda: the ribbon-twist framing theta_lambda^f is a PURE PHASE on the fibre. d_q(lambda)=[mark]_q (#3685/#3699) is real on the unit circle (= sin(m phi)/sin(phi) SU(2) character), so theta_lambda(zeta)=zeta^{c(lambda)} has |theta|=1 and the fibre probability |S_0lambda*theta^f|^2 = |S_0lambda|^2 = W_lambda(zeta) for EVERY block (framing phase cancels). Thus the observable W_lambda(q0)=d_q0^2/D^2 (the #3681 Habiro/probability ordering) is framing-FREE for all 7 blocks, not only the electron; the q0^{f*c} residual of #3701 is an amplitude-ordering artifact. Seifert framing pinned f=-1 (Sigma(2,3,5)=-1 surgery on the left trefoil; orbifold e=-1/30). Honest refocus: the open object is the modulus identification |S_0lambda^{Sigma(2,3,5)}|=d_zeta/D (the deferred colored Lawrence-Rozansky compute), NOT the framing. No fit.
